data.description:
## Description
**What**: Implement the atomic graduation write for an accepted candidate: the standard-amendment PR is drafted FIRST, and contributing bug tickets receive the promoted-to-standard:<rule-id> tag ONLY after PR creation succeeds (no tags if PR draft fails). behavioral-testing-standard.md remains a designated safeguard file: the Graduation Phase surfaces candidates and drafts rule text but MUST NOT auto-commit; human PR-merge approval remains required.
**Why**: Enforces atomic graduation ordering (SC6) and the safeguard-file no-auto-commit constraint (SC7), preventing phantom promotion records and protecting the safeguard boundary.
**Scope**:
- IN: PR-first draft of the standard amendment; promoted-to-standard:<rule-id> tagging gated on PR success with rollback semantics; assertion that no auto-commit to behavioral-testing-standard.md occurs; reviewer-assignment + deferred-merge handling per operational constraints.
- OUT: candidate identification / sycophancy gate (draft-5); lifecycle reopening hook (draft-7).

## Done Definitions

- On an accepted candidate the standard-amendment PR is created before any tagging, and promoted-to-standard:<rule-id> tags are applied to contributing bug tickets only after PR creation succeeds ← Satisfies: sc-6
- When PR draft creation fails no promoted-to-standard tags are applied to any contributing ticket (no phantom graduation record) ← Satisfies: sc-6
- The Graduation Phase produces the behavioral-testing-standard.md amendment only as PR content and performs no auto-commit or in-place write to the safeguard file ← Satisfies: sc-7
- The opened amendment PR is assigned to a human reviewer and merge approval remains a required human step that graduation does not perform ← Satisfies: sc-7
- Unit tests written and passing for all new or modified logic ← Satisfies: sc-6

## Considerations

- [Dependency] EXTERNAL BLOCKER: behavioral-testing-standard.md safeguard-file designation is owned by a03c-d55e SC2 / CLAUDE.md rule 22 — honor it, do not redefine it.
- [Safeguard] CLAUDE.md rule 22 prohibits auto-editing safeguard files; graduation drafts a PR only — tests must assert no working-tree mutation of behavioral-testing-standard.md outside the PR branch.
- [Operational] Per the epic operational-constraints table, sprint closure requires PR-opened + reviewer-assigned + a deferred-merge Phase I comment; in-session SC6 path is exercised against a synthetic fixture branch with gh PR create + close.

## Escalation Policy

**Escalation policy**: Proceed unless a significant assumption is required to continue — one that could send the implementation in the wrong direction. Escalate only when genuinely blocked without a reasonable inference. Document all assumptions made without escalating.
data.title: As a DSO maintainer, I want graduation to draft the PR first and only then tag contributing bugs, never auto-editing the safeguard file, so that the behavioral-testing-standard amendment stays human-gated and free of phantom graduation records.
